name: Canberra Summer Open 2027
information: ### The Eastlake Gungahlin club is a licenced venue and requires attendees to sign in. 18+ attendees must show photo ID to reception. ### Under 18 competitors must be accompanied by a responsible adult at all times. **Venue opening times** Access to the venue will not be availble prior to 9AM. ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)! [Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au) Speedcubing Australia acknowledges the traditional owners of this land, the Ngunnawal people, and pays respect to the elders, past and present for they hold the memories, the traditions, the culture and hopes of Aboriginal Australia.
